text.tspan: $489.22 a month for 5 yrs, at 6.5%. Interest
accrues daily on what is still owed, so a 31-day
month costs more than a 28-day one.
Interest accrues daily on what is still owed, so a 31-day month
costs more than a 28-day one. Assumes every payment lands on
time and the rate never moves — paying late costs the extra
days. Paying extra against the balance shortens the term.
